fields.statement: The BYO daemon scripts run a copy of docs/examples/byo/workflow.toml (myteam-flow) from their archive, picked by .rhiza/dispatch.toml [ready], held byte-identical to the docs file by a Go test; docker, make, gh, rex and claude are fakes on PATH and /myteam:implement is a stub skill under $HOME/.claude/skills
fields.wording: (planner, from the code: a testscript cannot read repo files; dispatch [ready] is how the daemon picks a non-default workflow)

fields.statement: A gate step with no stall= gets the watchdog's command limit (commandLimit, 30m default), as a command step does, instead of the agent retry limit it falls through to today; the built-in gates keep their explicit stall=70m
fields.wording: (planner, from the code: StallLimit in internal/api/watchdog_policy.go switches on command, wait and signoff only, so the BYO example's gate got the agent limit)

fields.statement: Stall and runaway detection on a BYO workflow's steps are shown by Go tests in internal/api over a BYO-shaped workflow (agent step work, gate step gate), not a testscript: the process table reader is nil under RHIZA_TEST_NOW
fields.wording: (planner, from the code: watchdogProcTable in internal/api/watchdog_runaway.go returns nil in tests)

fields.acceptance: env -u'd of RHIZA_*/SHIP_*/REX_*: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/byo-workflow-daemon$' passes: the daemon --once start names the myteam-flow run, the run reaches succeeded with each step in order, the fake docker logs 'compose down' from the cleanup, and rhiza run status --json shows intervention_count 0; (failure case) the first gate's fake make lint exits 1, the gate hands back to work with handback.md naming make lint, and the second gate passes; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestDocsExample' passes and fails when a script's archived .rhiza/workflows/myteam-flow.toml differs from docs/examples/byo/workflow.toml
fields.files: cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/byo-workflow-daemon.txtar, cmd/rhiza/main_test.go (processScripts entry with its reason), cmd/rhiza/docs_examples_test.go
fields.must_not: Change docs/examples/byo/*.toml; special-case a workflow or step name in production code; touch the network, Rex, a real agent, gh or docker; bind a unix socket
fields.statement: A testscript runs the BYO example workflow myteam-flow under the daemon end to end: the daemon picks it by dispatch [ready] for an accepted change set and its services, work, gate, signoff, push, wait-ci, merge and close-out steps pass, the stop-services cleanup runs, and the run ends succeeded with no journalled intervention

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run 'TestStallLimit|TestWatchdog|TestRunaway' passes, with new cases: StallLimit("gate", 0, 0) returns CommandLimit and an explicit stall still wins; a myteam-flow-shaped run silent in step work is nudged then stopped and resumed with --retry; one silent in step gate past commandLimit is stopped and resumed; a runaway work session (process count past the threshold from a fake process table) fails the step with the runaway reason; (failure case) a gate step still inside commandLimit is neither stopped nor nudged; rhiza docs regenerates docs/reference/config.md with commandLimit described as covering command and gate steps
fields.must_not: Change the built-in workflows' stall= values; special-case a workflow or step name; read the real process table in a test; run go test ./internal/api unscoped more than once
fields.statement: The watchdog's stall and runaway detection apply to a BYO workflow's steps: a gate step with no stall= gets the command limit, and Go tests over a BYO-shaped workflow show its agent step nudged then stopped and retried, its gate step stopped and retried past the command limit, and a runaway session of its agent step treated as a stall with the reason

fields.acceptance: env -u'd of RHIZA_*/SHIP_*/REX_*: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/byo-workflow-hold-intervention$' passes: with RHIZA_TEST_LOAD1/5 over maxLoad the work step does not start and rhiza inbox shows a held step session for the myteam-flow run; once the load drops the work session starts; a rhiza session message from outside the run to the work session leaves rhiza run status --json with intervention_count 1 naming the message; (failure case) a message the run's own session sends records no intervention
fields.files: cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/byo-workflow-hold-intervention.txtar, cmd/rhiza/main_test.go (processScripts entry if it starts a process); internal/api only for a gap found, fixed in the generic path
fields.must_not: Change docs/examples/byo/*.toml; special-case a workflow or step name; touch the network, Rex, a real agent, gh or docker; bind a unix socket
fields.statement: Under the daemon, the BYO example's work step session is held by the load hold like a built-in step's (held while load is high, started once it drops) and an outside rhiza session message to that session is journalled as an intervention shown by run status

fields.acceptance: env -u'd of RHIZA_*/SHIP_*/REX_*: go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/byo-workflow-retry$' passes: the fake close-out fails on its first call, the run fails at close-out, the next daemon --once poll resumes it from close-out (not from services or work), and it reaches succeeded with intervention_count 0; (failure case) with the failed-retry budget spent (rhiza.daemon.watchdog.retryBudget or the failed-retry count set to 0) the run stays failed and rhiza inbox lists it
fields.files: cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/byo-workflow-retry.txtar, cmd/rhiza/main_test.go (processScripts entry with its reason); internal/api only for a gap found, fixed in the generic path
fields.must_not: Change docs/examples/byo/*.toml; special-case a workflow or step name; touch the network, Rex, a real agent, gh or docker; bind a unix socket
fields.statement: Under the daemon, a BYO example run whose close-out step fails once (a transient command failure) is retried by the watchdog from that failed step with no one acting, and ends succeeded with no journalled intervention
